free_tier.stated: USD 300 of one-time Free Trial credit, valid for 90 days
free_tier.notes: Agent Sandbox on GKE is offered at no extra charge; GKE pricing applies to the resources created

interface_detail: Agent Sandbox Python client on a GKE cluster (Autopilot or Standard); the cluster is created and managed with the Google Cloud console and Cloud Shell

limits.value: GKE free tier: USD 74.40 in monthly credits per billing account, equivalent to one free Autopilot or zonal Standard cluster per month; the credit applies to the cluster charge only, not to compute, networking or other resources

limits_note: the Free Trial ends when 90 days pass or the USD 300 is spent; the Free Trial billing account is then closed and its projects and resources are stopped unless upgraded to a paid billing account

identity_cost.detail: a credit card or other payment method valid for the Free Trial period is required at signup; identity and payment method are verified before the trial starts; bank account verification may be required depending on country; eligibility requires never having been a paying user of Google Cloud, Google Maps Platform or Firebase and no earlier Free Trial signup

confidence_note: documented from first-party Google Cloud pages: the Agent Sandbox how-to (no extra charge), the Free Trial terms (USD 300, 90 days, payment method at signup) and the GKE pricing page (free tier); the earlier concept page URL is not found
